company.name: Marqeta
company.shortDescription: Marqeta is a card issuing platform that provides infrastructure and tools to help companies build and manage payment programs.
company.description: Marqeta’s modern card issuing platform empowers its customers to create customized and innovative payment cards. Marqeta’s platform, powered by open APIs, gives its customers the ability to build more configurable and flexible payment experiences, accelerating product development and democratizing access to card-issuing technology. Its modern architecture provides instant access to highly scalable, cloud-based payment infrastructure that enables customers to launch and manage their own card programs, issue cards, and authorize and settle transactions. Marqeta is headquartered in Oakland, California, and is certified to operate in 40 countries globally.

aiResearchSummary.text: Marqeta is researching systems for embedding credit-based systems into non-credit-based systems, as described in 'Embedding credit-based systems in existing non-credit-based systems to generate.' Efforts also include real-time card transaction processing with cached balance inspection, computer transaction security with delegated decisions, and just-in-time funding of payment card accounts. Additional work covers cryptographic key lifecycle management, error detection in transaction databases, and blockchain-enabled payment transaction rerouting.
